target_customer: AI inference providers, neoclouds and research computing teams running GPU workloads on Kubernetes and Slurm
problem: GPU workloads cannot be paused and moved, so cold starts, node failures and idle capacity waste expensive compute.
business_model: Open source CLI plus managed enterprise service
product_category: GPU and CPU live migration infrastructure

founders.name: Neel Master
previous_startups: Engooden (AI chronic disease management, Series B)
founders.background_notes: Former VP of Corporate Development at Petra Systems per the YC page; patents and publications in AI and computer vision.

founders.name: Niranjan Ravichandra
founders.background_notes: Robotics at Shopify and an aerospace and control systems research background per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Checkpointing and restoring GPU state at the CUDA driver layer without code changes is research grade systems engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Deep systems expertise is hard to replicate, though NVIDIA cuda-checkpoint with CRIU and other vendors later offered related capabilities.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Hyperscalers built similar capabilities internally per the company. NVIDIA later released cuda-checkpoint and Dynamo Snapshot per its blog.

market_need_then: Demand for GPU efficiency rose with the 2023 generative AI boom and GPU scarcity. The company claims up to 80 percent cost savings.

branding.domain_note: Used cedana.ai and now redirects to cedana.com.

identity.logo: Not described by any source opened
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and performance focused, builds in the open

branding.brand_signature: Open source CLI and the phrase OS for AI factories

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand itself was found. Search for the name returns unrelated names such as Cedano and Cedda.

outcome_analysis: Cedana is a small, deeply technical YC S23 team with an AWS Marketplace listing and a pitch to inference providers and neoclouds, still hiring in 2026. No verified round beyond YC was found, so traction is unclear, and larger vendors including NVIDIA moved into checkpoint and restore for GPUs.
notes: VCBacked and CB Insights report 500K total pre-seed or convertible note in September 2023 from Y Combinator, Pebblebed and Wayfinder, aggregators only and unverified. Pebblebed's portfolio page confirms an investment in 2023 but gives no round or amount, so no round is recorded. No competitor sources dated near 2023 were found, so the list is empty. No founder education was found. Pebblebed and Wayfinder were named only in aggregators.
